tool.name: nf-core duphold
tool.description: SV callers like lumpy look at split-reads and pair distances to find structural variants. This tool is a fast way to add depth information to those calls. This can be used as additional information for filtering variants; for example we will be skeptical of deletion calls that do not have lower than average coverage compared to regions with similar gc-content.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ duphold \\ ${args} \\ --threads ${task.cpus} \\ --output ${prefix}.vcf.gz \\ --vcf ${sv_variants} \\ --bam ${alignment_file} \\ --fasta ${fasta} \\ ${snp_annotation}
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": duphold: \$(duphold -h | head -n 1 | sed -e "s/^version: //") END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
SV callers like lumpy look at split-reads and pair distances to find structural variants. This tool is a fast way to add depth information to those calls. This can be used as additional information for filtering variants; for example we will be skeptical of deletion calls that do not have lower than average coverage compared to regions with similar gc-content.
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: duphold Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
